contracts: The request is bound to the intended subject identity; promotion and evaluation-set admission both terminate as rejected, with no baseline or evaluation-set authority mutation and a machine-verifiable non-authorizing result.
selector_intents: A promotion request is accepted or records baseline authority for a seed, package, or Skill version.
An evaluation-set admission request succeeds or marks a seed, package, or Skill version as an evaluation-set authority within TC-D1.
The validator evaluates a different subject than the requested seed, package, or Skill version, or cannot bind the request to its canonical repository-relative identity.
